business_logic.responsibility: Orchestrate domain operations and coordinate infrastructure services

domain.responsibility: Pure business logic with value semantics
domain.constraints: Zero external dependencies, immutable structs only, Sendable-safe

infrastructure.responsibility: External concerns (MLX, WhisperKit, AssemblyAI, CoreData, APIs)

architecture_summary.dependency_rule: Dependencies flow inward only: Presentation → Business → Domain ← Infrastructure

dependency_injection.lifecycle: Singleton vs transient defined per service

strengths.details: Zero external framework dependencies; only Foundation imports. Immutable value types with strong ID typing prevent accidental mixing.
All layer boundaries use protocols. Infrastructure implementations are swappable (MLX ↔ WhisperKit ↔ AssemblyAI).
Hierarchical error types with associated values enable precise handling and debugging context.
Clear actor strategy: @MainActor for UI, custom actors for domain state (TranscriptionActor, SessionActor).

concerns.details: SessionRepository (2.1K lines to be split) suggests current high coupling. Migration must decompose into SessionRepository, TranscriptRepository, SettingsRepository.
NotesView (3.7K lines) migration to use cases requires careful decomposition to avoid just moving the bloat.
Three-level protocol hierarchy (TranscriptionService → Streaming/Batch → Concrete) adds complexity but necessary for multi-provider support.
Four factory types (Service, ViewModel, UseCase, AppContainer) may be over-engineered; consider simplifying to 2-3 factories.

risks_identified.title: 36K Line Codebase Migration Over 9 Weeks
risks_identified.description: Migrating from 'Big Ball of Mud' (36K lines) to Clean Architecture over 9 weeks with 5 phases. NotesView (3.7K lines) and SessionRepository (2.1K lines) are god objects requiring careful decomposition.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TASK-008: Phased migration with feature flags, rollback plans per phase, parallel old/new code during transition
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Any phase exceeding 1 week without checkpoint, or >5 files touched simultaneously

risks_identified.title: Strict Concurrency Compliance
risks_identified.description: Swift 6.2 StrictConcurrency requires all cross-actor types to be Sendable. 36K lines of legacy code likely has data races that will become compile errors.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TASK-011: Sendable-safe design from start; use actors for shared state; compile with -strict-concurrency=complete

risks_identified.title: Multi-Provider Transcription Complexity
risks_identified.description: Supporting MLX, WhisperKit, AssemblyAI, Parakeet with different capabilities (streaming vs batch) requires complex protocol hierarchy and error mapping.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TASK-010: Adapter pattern for framework isolation; comprehensive error mapping; factory for backend instantiation
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Backend switching causes data loss or crashes

risks_identified.title: Layer Abstraction Overhead
risks_identified.description: Clean architecture adds indirection. Budget of 5% overhead (PERF-003) may be challenging with protocol dispatch and actor hopping.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From PERF-003: Prototype validation; hot path optimization; benchmark comparison of layered vs direct
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Latency exceeds 500ms or overhead >5% in benchmarks

risks_identified.title: DI Container Complexity
risks_identified.description: Four factory types may lead to over-engineering and runtime dependency resolution errors.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TASK-007: Composition root resolves all at startup; explicit lifecycle management; compile-time circular dependency detection
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Circular dependency runtime errors or difficult test configuration

risks_identified.title: SessionRepository Decomposition
risks_identified.description: Splitting 2.1K line SessionRepository into focused repositories requires maintaining backward compatibility during migration.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TASK-008: Feature flag to use old repo; integration tests for both paths; gradual cutover
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Data loss or corruption during repository split

risks_identified.title: Baseline Measurement and Tooling
risks_identified.description: AST analysis requires eedom/gitnexus setup. Without baseline metrics, cannot verify improvement targets.
risks_identified.mitigation_plan: From TC-011: Index codebase before migration; document baseline; run queries at each phase; OpenGrep for quick validation
risks_identified.trigger_condition: Cannot measure hotpoint metrics during migration

recommendations.recommendation: Simplify 5-phase migration to 3 phases: (1) Domain + Infrastructure, (2) Business Logic, (3) Presentation. Reduces complexity and checkpoint overhead.
recommendations.rationale: 9 weeks with 5 phases creates too many transition points. 3 phases of 3 weeks each provides better focus and fewer rollback points.

recommendations.recommendation: Reduce factory types from 4 to 2: ServiceFactory (Infrastructure), CompositionRoot (Business + Presentation). Eliminate ViewModelFactory and UseCaseFactory.
recommendations.rationale: Simpler DI graph reduces cognitive load and potential circular dependencies. UseCase creation is trivial enough for direct instantiation.

recommendations.recommendation: Create Swift 6.2 prototype before migration begins. Compile with -strict-concurrency=complete to identify blocking issues early.
recommendations.rationale: Legacy code likely has concurrency violations. Early prototype prevents migration-blocking compiler errors.

recommendations.recommendation: Run AST baseline queries (TC-011) BEFORE design sign-off. Document actual hotpoint counts for NotesView and SessionRepository.
recommendations.rationale: Without baseline, cannot verify improvement. Current estimates ('likely has god functions') need concrete numbers.

recommendations.recommendation: Flatten protocol hierarchy: TranscriptionService with capability flags instead of Streaming/Batch sub-protocols.
recommendations.rationale: Simpler protocol reduces complexity while still supporting all backends. Check capabilities at runtime rather than compile-time.

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit contract tests for each integration point using Swift protocols + XCTest.
recommendations.rationale: Protocol conformance alone doesn't guarantee behavioral contracts. Explicit tests verify error handling, cancellation, and resource cleanup.

recommendations.recommendation: Consider CQRS pattern for SessionRepository: separate read and write models to reduce complexity.
recommendations.rationale: 2.1K lines suggests mixed responsibilities. CQRS separates query optimization from write consistency.

recommendations.recommendation: Identify 'hot paths' (audio → transcription → UI) and allow direct protocol calls without UseCase indirection for latency-critical operations.
recommendations.rationale: Strict Clean Architecture can add overhead. Hot paths may need pragmatic shortcuts within the abstraction.

recommendations.recommendation: Configure OpenGrep rules for layer violations and force unwraps before migration begins.
recommendations.rationale: Early enforcement prevents regression. Standalone OpenGrep is fast for pre-commit hooks.

SAFETY-005_Exhaustive_Error_Handling.evidence: Error taxonomy defined; associated values provide context; no force unwraps in design

SAFETY-006_Sendable_Safe_Concurrency.evidence: All domain types Sendable; actors for shared state; strict concurrency compile planned

SAFETY-007_Backend_Failure_Isolation.evidence: Backend abstraction with error mapping; factory pattern for instantiation

LIVENESS-002_Transcription_Progress.evidence: AsyncStream for segments; 5-second emission target during active speech

LIVENESS-004_Session_Persistence.evidence: Repository pattern; 2-second persistence target after session completion

LIVENESS-005_Cancellation_Responsiveness.evidence: Task cancellation designed into protocols; 500ms response target

INVARIANT-001_Unidirectional_Data_Flow.evidence: Presentation → Business → Infrastructure; diagrams verify no callbacks upward

INVARIANT-002_Protocol_Based_APIs.evidence: All layer boundaries use protocols; concrete types only in DI/tests

INVARIANT-004_Complete_Error_Propagation.evidence: Error mapping from Infrastructure → Domain → Presentation defined

INVARIANT-005_Backend_Config_Isolation.evidence: Separate configuration structs per backend; no shared mutable state

INVARIANT-007_Backward_Compatibility.evidence: 5-phase migration with feature flags; rollback plans per phase
